heading.title: Support & Frequently Asked Questions
heading.text: Find quick answers to common questions about our services, plans, and support.

general.question: What is RailWire broadband?
general.answer: RailWire is a high-speed fiber broadband service designed to deliver fast, stable, and reliable internet connectivity for both homes and businesses. It uses advanced fiber-optic technology to ensure better speed, low latency, and uninterrupted performance for activities like streaming, online classes, gaming, and office work.

general.question: How long does installation take?
general.answer: Installation is usually completed within 1 to 3 working days after your request is confirmed. The exact time may vary depending on your location, network availability, and technical feasibility. Our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

general.question: How can I apply for a new connection?
general.answer: Getting a new connection is simple. You can apply directly through our website by filling out the connection form, or you can contact your nearest local partner. Once your request is received, our team will verify your location, guide you through the available plans, and schedule installation at your convenience.

general.question: What documents are required for a new connection?
general.answer: You may be asked to provide basic identity and address details. Please confirm the required documents with your local RailWire service provider. To process your connection request, you will need a valid identity proof such as an Aadhar card, a passport-size photograph, and an active mobile number. These details are required for registration and verification purposes to ensure a smooth onboarding process.

general.question: Is RailWire available in my area?
general.answer: RailWire services are rapidly expanding across urban and rural regions. To check availability, you can enter your location on our website or contact our support team. If service is not currently available, we may still be able to assist through nearby partners.

support.question: What should I do if my internet is not working?
support.answer: If your internet stops working, first try restarting your router by turning it off and on after a few seconds. Check if cables are properly connected. If the issue continues, contact our support team or your local partner for quick assistance.

support.question: How can I check my internet speed?
support.answer: You can check your internet speed using online tools like Speedtest. Simply open the website and click “Go” to measure your download and upload speeds. For accurate results, ensure no other devices are using the network during the test.

support.question: How do I change my WiFi password?
support.answer: To change your WiFi password, log in to your router settings using the IP address (usually mentioned on the router). Enter your username and password, navigate to wireless settings, and update your WiFi password. Save changes and reconnect your devices.

support.question: How can I contact customer support?
support.answer: You can reach our customer support team via phone, WhatsApp, or email. Our support team is available to assist you with installation, billing, and technical issues to ensure a smooth experience.

support.question: What should I do if my connection is slow?
support.answer: If your internet speed is slow, check for background downloads, limit the number of connected devices, and restart your router. If the issue persists, contact support to check for network issues or plan-related limitations.

plans.question: What are the available plans?
plans.answer: RailWire offers a variety of broadband plans tailored to different needs, including home users, small businesses, and enterprises. Plans vary based on speed, data usage, and pricing, allowing you to choose the one that best suits your requirements.

plans.question: Are the plans unlimited?
plans.answer: Yes, most RailWire plans come with unlimited data usage. However, under the Fair Usage Policy (FUP), speeds may be reduced after a certain data limit is reached. This ensures fair usage across all users while still providing continuous internet access.

plans.question: How can I pay my bill?
plans.answer: You can conveniently pay your bills online using UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking, or through your local service provider. Some partners may also offer offline payment options. Timely payment ensures uninterrupted service.

plans.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
plans.answer: Yes, you have the flexibility to upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Simply contact our support team or your local partner, and they will assist you in selecting and activating a new plan based on your needs.

plans.question: Will I receive a bill or invoice?
plans.answer: Yes, a detailed invoice is generated for every payment you make. You can access it through your account or receive it from your service provider. This helps you track your usage and billing history.

anpPage.badgeFor: For Local Cable Operators who have an active network of subscribers with co-axial/optical fiber connectivity.
anpPage.heroDesc: RailTel works with MSPs and ANPs to take high speed broadband internet to all parts of the country through its 61,000+ km optical fibre backbone and you could qualify to become a partner in making wired broadband available to your community. Not only will this add to your monthly income, but you will also serve as an example of local entrepreneurship to thousands of young minds in your area.
anpPage.definition: A RailWire ANP is a Local Cable Operator with at least 50 active cable subscribers on optical fibre, co-axial cable or wireless connectivity.
anpPage.s1: Formal building permission is obtained from building owners or apartment associations. Permissions shall include, but not be limited to allocating space for equipment rack, LAN switch, fiber termination in the Building & premises. Power supply arrangement & right to draw electricity from the building/apartment and in-building/premises. Cable-laying works to connect subscribers.
anpPage.s2: Charges, if any, towards electricity drawn from the building payable by the ANP. In the event the building owner or building association demands rental charges towards rack-space, the same is borne by the ANP.
anpPage.s3: The access network from RailTel’s POP to the customer premises is built and maintained by the ANP.
anpPage.s4: The ANP provides end-to-end customer premise installation and support, ensuring optimal fiber line connectivity.
anpPage.s5: The ANP delivers prompt troubleshooting and local maintenance to minimize any network downtime.
anpPage.s6: Continuous coordination with RailTel and the MSP ensures top-tier broadband quality for every subscriber.

mspPage.heroDesc: Join hands with RailTel as a Managed Service Partner to drive broadband infrastructure, partner enablement, and network operations across entire regions.
services: RailWire's Managed Service Partner (MSP) identifies prospective Access Network Providers (ANPs) to be the Multi-Service Operators (MSOs) or the Local Cable Operators (LCOs), evangelizes RailWire business and its uniqueness with the ANPs. MSP short-lists and selects suitable ANPs, leading to signing of agreements between RailTel, the MSP & the ANP. RailTel arranges for connectivity of the ANP location(s) to the RailTel network.

MSP manages the ANP Networks, Billing and Customer Support through the centrally-hosted Operational Support Software System (OSS), Business Support Software System (BSS), Network Management Software System (NMS) and Customer Relationship Management Software System (CRM) of RailTel. MSP will always have access to RailTel's OSS, BSS, NMS and CRM systems.
MSP arranges the requisite infrastructure along with IT accessories like Personal Computers/Thin Clients at its own cost for managing the OSS, BSS, NMS, and CRM systems.
MSP arranges other supporting infrastructure like commercial AC power, alternate power source, UPS battery sets, air-conditioning (cooling), space, and staff.

RailTel connects the MSP Location through fiber/RF from its nearest available network along with all necessary hardware for availability of access to RailTel's centrally-hosted OSS, BSS, NMS, and CRM systems. Wherever feasible, subject to availability, RailTel will offer to the MSP its raw space at nominal price such that the MSP can renovate and create requisite infrastructure for RailWire offices and support centre(s).
MSP facilitates call-center services at its own cost, which will interface with RailTel's toll-free number and handle queries, complaints, and extend maintenance support to RailWire customers.
MSP resolves direct queries of the customers through e-mails addressed to webmaster/helpdesk.
MSP operates a service-center together with requisite skilled manpower on a 24x7x365 basis, specifically for RailWire customers.

MSP ensures that all legal obligations required of an ISP, as mandated by the DoT, including keeping KYC data are fulfilled. These records and processes are made available for monthly and/or quarterly inspection by RailTel and/or DoT officials.

MSP does the revenue collections from ANPs, does the accounting and settlement through the RailWire Billing System. Based on prepayment, RailWire connections are provisioned by RailTel through its regional/territorial Network Operating Centers (NOCs).

RailTel ensures that all revenue collection from ANPs are deposited into an escrow account in a nationalized/first class commercial Bank, opened and maintained by RailTel and reconciled on a monthly basis. The appropriation of revenue to RailTel and MSP is carried out on a weekly basis. Likewise, RailTel reconciles the monthly Bank receipts with the RailWire-provided data in order to confirm complete billing and realization. From time-to-time, the services of the MSP gets audited by RailTel officials and/or third party auditors. Payments to the ANPs are facilitated through a payment gateway.

MSP pursues targets fixed by the joint working group (JWG) consisting of RailTel and ANP officials. MSP deploys necessary resources for branding, marketing, and sales of RailWire services. In consultation with the JWG, MSP organizes outdoor advertisements, print and electronic media advertisements, road-shows, tele-marketing, SMS campaign etc. RailTel will provide the creative inputs for brand-building and campaign advertisements.

MSP educates the ANPs in evangelizing the concept of RailWire and its uniqueness to apartment associations, builders community, various residential colonies as well as the retail community. MSP educates the ANPs on the design rules of the RailWire network that needs to be followed by the ANPs when rolling-out their Aggregation Network, Edge Network, and/or In-Building Network for RailWire. MSPs employ adequate staff trained in networking.

On a need basis, MSP may enter into independent agreements with financial institutions to offer loan facilities to RailWire subscribers for bundled offerings from RailWire – hardware, other devices, or 3rd party software licences. RailTel will not be a party to this agreement. MSP operates a service-center together with requisite skilled manpower on a 24x7x365 basis, specifically for RailWire customers.
MSP shares with RailTel copies of all agreements signed by MSPs in connection with RailWire business, whether or not such agreement required the approval of RailTel.

MSP may procure and supply access network equipment, customer premise equipment (CPE), ethernet-over-coaxial cable modems at competitive rates to ANPs. MSP takes RailTel's approval for technical suitability of equipment being deployed in access bandwidth by the ANP.

MSP measures periodically the customer experience of brand-RailWire in accordance with customer experience fulfilment standards laid down by RailTel so as to ensure that RailWire subscribers perceive similar quality of service irrespective of the Circle/Region that the MSP services.

wifiSetup.title: Guide for wifi Setup – Wi-Fi connection is simple and quick
wifiSetup.body: Setting up your RailWire Wi-Fi connection is simple and quick. Connect the router power adapter and plug the internet/fiber cable into the WAN/Internet port, then switch on the router and wait for the indicator lights to stabilize. On your mobile, laptop, or smart TV, open Wi-Fi settings, select your RailWire network name (SSID), and enter the Wi-Fi password provided on the router sticker or by the technician. For better security, you can change your Wi-Fi name and password by logging into the router settings through 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1. To enjoy the best speed and uninterrupted streaming experience, place the router in a central open location away from walls and electronic interference. If you face any connectivity issues, simply restart the router or contact RailWire customer support at 1800-103-9139 for assistance.
